description: Turn categorised bank-statement totals into balance sheet figures, applying the rules that stop an import lying: only income categories reach turnover, only expense categories reach operating costs, and the owner topping up the account is never sales. Totals are signed major units per category code; get codes from categorise_transactions.

totals.description: Signed totals per category code, major units, e.g. {"sales": 60000, "software": -1200}.

name: totals_to_figures
